278742117.description: This lot includes four vintage glass electrical insulators used for telegraph, telephone, and power lines. The insulators are made by Hemingray, an American manufacturer, with embossed markings such as 'Hemingray-42' and 'Hemingray-56'. Each insulator features a cylindrical shape with ridged sides and domed tops, measuring approximately 4 to 5 inches in height. The glass colors include clear and aqua/teal. The items are in good vintage condition with no major chips or cracks, showing minor wear consistent with age. Suitable for collectors or craft projects.

278306780.description: This large natural agate geode specimen features a polished face that reveals striking blue-gray and white banding with crystal formations at the center. The exterior retains its original rough texture with earthy brown, green, and tan tones. The piece weighs approximately 2.1 lbs and measures about 4 inches tall by 5.5 inches wide. There are price and inventory stickers from Goodwill on one side, and the specimen shows no visible major damage.

278100443.description: Vintage briar wood smoking pipe with dark, textured rusticated finish. Features a classic straight black stem made of plastic or vulcanite, accented with a silver or metallic ring at the shank. Cylindrical bowl with rugged carved exterior. Good used condition with no visible cracks or major chips. No visible brand markings or model numbers. Suitable for pipe collectors and tobacco memorabilia enthusiasts.

278262880.description:
Unopened whole geode packaged for breaking open at home. The tan and cream stone has a bumpy, nodular outer surface with gray mineral speckling and a small pink paint dot on one side. It arrives sealed in clear plastic wrap with a printed card from Stoneworks Lapidary titled Break Your Own Geode, noting that these geodes are found in Morocco and instructing the user to tap moderately with a hammer until they crack open to reveal the crystal structure inside, wrapping the stone in a cloth or wearing safety glasses first. Includes the geode, the wrap and the instruction card. The interior has not been opened, so the crystal formation inside is unknown.

Condition: Unopened and intact. Loose sandy grit and a few small stone crumbs inside the wrap. Small pink paint mark on the surface.
